title: 30-MINUTE SEALED CODING STRESS BASELINE
purpose: Measure the exact System Master Second Shift ChatGPT scheduled development worker's software-engineering performance under a controlled, timed, previously unseen coding assignment, with A-01 serving as the controlled Windows/X64 execution, timing-corroboration, freeze, and evidence host. This qualification is distinct from repository-wide PQF quality measurement.

establishes: performance of the bound Second Shift ChatGPT authoring subject on this exact sealed benchmark instance and time window
functional correctness and engineering-quality evidence produced by the evaluator
behavioral evidence about planning, implementation, testing, debugging, scope discipline, and recovery during the run
A-01-hosted corroboration of candidate identity, freeze, timing evidence, and final artifact identity when the registered host boundary executes
does_not_establish: that A-01 itself authored the measured code
that all System Master code is high quality
that future authoring runs will achieve the same result
that a repository-wide quality threshold has been satisfied
that the first baseline score is a pass/fail quality threshold

separation_of_concerns.pqf_001f: Repository-wide multi-language coverage, complexity, and duplication baseline.
separation_of_concerns.a01_code_qual_001: A-01-hosted controlled measurement of code authored by the exact bound Second Shift ChatGPT scheduled development worker during a sealed timed assignment.
separation_of_concerns.a01_host: Windows/X64 execution, timing corroboration, evidence, freeze, and qualification host; not the code-authoring subject.

timing.timer_starts_when: The fresh eligible Second Shift ChatGPT authoring session receives the sealed candidate assignment and writable benchmark workspace.
timing.timer_stops_when: An external control boundary terminates candidate mutation at 1,800 wall-clock seconds or on explicit earlier submission, whichever occurs first.

authoring_subject.unavailable_platform_metadata_policy: Record as unavailable; never infer or fabricate it.

all_must_hold: sealed candidate assignment and exact hidden evaluator instance were fixed before authoring access
a fresh eligible Second Shift ChatGPT session authored the candidate
the authoring subject had no human assistance during the timed window
the authoring subject was technically restricted to the candidate mutation boundary
the hard 30-minute boundary was externally enforced rather than requested only by prompt
no post-deadline mutation was included in the measured artifact
available authoring subject identities and digests were captured without guessing unavailable platform metadata
A-01 host/freeze evidence was captured when required by the execution architecture
exact subject identities and digests were captured
hidden evaluator executed only after the measured coding window
raw evidence and machine-readable receipt were preserved immutably
